content.text: Pretty common at 5, and it's very fixable. Tonight, tell Milo the new plan before bedtime: he starts in his own bed, and if he wakes up he can come to your door, where you'll walk him straight back. Keep it calm and boring, with no talking and no negotiating. Then add a small reward he can see, like a sticker chart for each morning he wakes up in his own bed.
